name: Taima Miko Yui ~Sanketsu Kakusei Choukyou~
original_name: 退魔巫女由衣～三穴覚醒調教～
source:
Yui is a shrine maiden who protects her shrine in spiritual battle with darkness once per month. Virginity gives a huge boost to this power, so darkness minion infiltrates her school in an attempt to deprive her of virginity.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
天河由衣是一名巫女，每个月都要在灵界之战中守护神社，对抗黑暗。处女之身能够大幅增强她的力量，因此，黑暗的爪牙潜入她的学校，企图夺走她的贞洁。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
